cat > persistence/user_props_repository_test.go <<'EOF'
package persistence

import (
	\"context\"

	\"github.com/astaxie/beego/orm\"
	\"github.com/navidrome/navidrome/model\"
	\"github.com/navidrome/navidrome/model/request\"
	. \"github.com/onsi/ginkgo\"
	. \"github.com/onsi/gomega\"
)

var _ = Describe(\"User properties\", func() {
	It(\"isolates keys by contextual user and supports update and delete\", func() {
		first := NewUserPropsRepository(request.WithUser(context.Background(), model.User{ID: \"user-a\"}), orm.NewOrm())
		second := NewUserPropsRepository(request.WithUser(context.Background(), model.User{ID: \"user-b\"}), orm.NewOrm())
		Expect(first.Put(\"shared\", \"one\")).To(Succeed())
		Expect(second.Put(\"shared\", \"two\")).To(Succeed())
		value, err := first.Get(\"shared\")
		Expect(err).NotTo(HaveOccurred())
		Expect(value).To(Equal(\"one\"))
		Expect(first.Put(\"shared\", \"updated\")).To(Succeed())
		Expect(first.Delete(\"shared\")).To(Succeed())
		_, err = first.Get(\"shared\")
		Expect(err).To(Equal(model.ErrNotFound))
		value, err = second.Get(\"shared\")
		Expect(err).NotTo(HaveOccurred())
		Expect(value).To(Equal(\"two\"))
	})
})
EOF

item.text:
Added a `user_props` migration and a context-scoped `UserPropsRepository`, exposed through `DataStore.UserProps`. Last.fm now stores session keys under the `sessionKeyProperty` constant, and the migration transfers existing prefixed keys. Session-key error logging now includes the request ID when available.

The new test verifies that users can hold different values for the same key. `go test ./...` passed.
